cohort: 99 women with twin pregnancies > 24 weeks of gestation with previous cesarean section at the maternity center of Nancy (France) from January 1st, 2002 to December 31st, 2016
finding: Trial of labor after cesarean in twin pregnancies did not increase maternal and neonatal complications and was associated with reduced blood loss and shorter hospitalization duration.
mod_finding: Trial of labor after cesarean in twin pregnancies did not increase maternal and neonatal complications.
